Aurora Dynamics (Pvt.) Ltd.
Company Policy Handbook - Version 4.2 (September 2026)
This document sets out the core policies that govern day-to-day work at Aurora Dynamics. Please read it
carefully and contact People Operations with any questions.
1. Introduction and Scope
This Company Policy document applies to all employees, contractors and interns of Aurora Dynamics
(Pvt.) Ltd. ("Aurora Dynamics" or "the Company") across all offices, including the Lahore headquarters and
the Karachi and Dubai offices.
The policy was last reviewed on 1 September 2026 and is reviewed annually by the People Operations
team. Where this document conflicts with a signed employment contract, the contract prevails.
2. Code of Conduct

team. Where this document conflicts with a signed employment contract, the contract prevails.
2. Code of Conduct
Employees are expected to act with integrity, treat colleagues and clients with respect, and protect
confidential information. Harassment or discrimination of any kind is not tolerated and should be reported
to People Operations or through the anonymous ethics hotline.
Conflicts of interest, including outside employment with a competitor, must be disclosed in writing to your
line manager before they arise.
3. Working Hours and Attendance
Standard working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, with a one-hour lunch break, for a
total of 40 working hours per week. Core hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, during which all employees must

total of 40 working hours per week. Core hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, during which all employees must
be available regardless of where they work.
Overtime must be approved in advance by the line manager. Approved overtime is compensated with time
off in lieu at a rate of 1:1, to be taken within 60 days.
Attendance is recorded through the PeopleHub portal. Repeated unexplained lateness may lead to
disciplinary action under Section 8.

4. Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
Aurora Dynamics operates a hybrid work model. After successfully completing probation, employees may
work remotely for up to 3 days per week, subject to written approval from their line manager. Employees
on probation are expected to work from the office full-time unless otherwise agreed.
Remote work days must be logged in PeopleHub at least one day in advance. Employees working
remotely must be reachable during core hours (10:00 AM to 4:00 PM) and must connect through the
company VPN when accessing internal systems.
The Company may require in-office attendance for client visits, onboarding, team events and performance
reviews, even on a scheduled remote day.
5. Probation and Confirmation

reviews, even on a scheduled remote day.
5. Probation and Confirmation
All new employees serve a probation period of 3 months from their start date. During probation, either
party may terminate employment with 2 weeks' notice.
At the end of probation the line manager completes a probation review in PeopleHub. Based on the
review, employment is either confirmed or the probation period is extended once by up to 3 additional
months. Probation cannot be extended more than once.
Employees on probation are not eligible for remote work days (Section 4) or the annual learning budget
until their employment is confirmed.
6. Expense and Travel Policy
Employees may claim reimbursement for reasonable business expenses. All claims must be submitted

6. Expense and Travel Policy
Employees may claim reimbursement for reasonable business expenses. All claims must be submitted
through PeopleHub within 30 days of the expense being incurred; claims older than 30 days are rejected
automatically.
Receipts are mandatory for every expense above PKR 2,000 (or USD 10 for expenses incurred abroad).
Approved claims are reimbursed with the next payroll run, no later than 14 days after approval.
Travel allowances: a daily per diem of PKR 5,000 applies to domestic travel and USD 75 to international
travel. Flights are booked in economy class. Hotel accommodation is capped at PKR 15,000 per night for
domestic travel unless approved by the Head of People Operations.

7. IT and Information Security Policy
All company laptops are managed devices. Passwords must be changed every 90 days and multi-factor
authentication (MFA) is mandatory for email, PeopleHub, the VPN and all cloud consoles.
Personal USB storage devices may not be connected to company laptops. Company data must only be
stored in approved locations (company Google Drive and the internal GitLab).
Suspected phishing emails must be reported to security@auroradynamics.example within one hour of
receipt. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT Support immediately so the device can be remotely
wiped.
Company laptops are refreshed every 3 years. Employees may request a replacement earlier only if the
device fails a repair assessment by IT Support.
8. Disciplinary Procedure

8. Disciplinary Procedure
Minor breaches result in a verbal warning, followed by a written warning if repeated. Serious misconduct,
including breaches of Section 7, may result in immediate suspension pending investigation and can lead to
termination.
Employees have the right to be accompanied by a colleague at any disciplinary meeting and may appeal a
decision in writing to the Head of People Operations within 7 days.
9. Policy Review
This policy is owned by People Operations and reviewed every 12 months. Questions about any section
should be sent to people@auroradynamics.example.

Aurora Dynamics Employee Handbook
Edition 2026 - Prepared by People Operations

Welcome to Aurora Dynamics
Welcome aboard! Aurora Dynamics is an AI and cloud engineering company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Lahore, with additional offices in Karachi and Dubai. This handbook summarises the most important things you need to know in your first months. Detailed rules live in the Company Policy Handbook and the Leave Policy, both available on PeopleHub.

Onboarding Checklist
- Day 1: collect your laptop and ID badge from IT Support; enable MFA on all accounts.
- Week 1: complete the security awareness training and sign the Code of Conduct.
- Week 2: meet your onboarding buddy and set 30/60/90-day goals with your manager.
- Month 3: probation review meeting with your line manager.

Your First 90 Days (Probation)
Every new employee completes a 3-month probation period. Your manager will hold a probation review at the end of month three, after which your employment is confirmed or, in rare cases, probation is extended once by up to 3 months. During probation the notice period is 2 weeks for both you and the Company, and remote work days are not yet available.

Leave at a Glance
Employees receive 20 paid annual leave days per calendar year. The table below summarises every leave type; the full rules, including carryover limits, are in the Leave Policy.
Leave type: Annual leave | Entitlement per year: 20 paid days | Notes: Up to 5 unused days may be carried over
Leave type: Sick leave | Entitlement per year: 10 paid days | Notes: Medical certificate after 2 consecutive days
Leave type: Casual leave | Entitlement per year: 6 paid days | Notes: For urgent personal matters
Leave type: Maternity leave | Entitlement per year: 12 weeks paid | Notes: Notify People Ops 8 weeks in advance
Leave type: Paternity leave | Entitlement per year: 2 weeks paid | Notes: To be taken within 3 months of birth

Leave type: Paternity leave | Entitlement per year: 2 weeks paid | Notes: To be taken within 3 months of birth
Leave type: Adoption leave | Entitlement per year: 4 weeks paid | Notes: Primary carer
Leave type: Unpaid leave | Entitlement per year: Up to 30 days | Notes: Requires Head of People Operations approval

Benefits
Aurora Dynamics offers the following benefits to all confirmed employees. Benefits are administered through PeopleHub.
Benefit: Health insurance | Details: Covers the employee, spouse and up to 2 children. Inpatient care fully covered; outpatient up to PKR 50,000 per year. Dental and optical treatment are NOT covered.
Benefit: Provident fund | Details: 8% employee contribution matched by an 8% Company contribution.
Benefit: Learning budget | Details: USD 1,000 per year for courses, certifications and conferences (available after probation).
Benefit: Referral bonus | Details: PKR 50,000 paid after the referred hire completes probation.
Benefit: Laptop | Details: Company laptop refreshed every 3 years.

Performance and Growth
Performance reviews take place twice a year, in June and December. Salary increments and promotions are decided in the December cycle. Every employee sets quarterly OKRs with their manager.

Resignation and Notice Period
Confirmed employees must give 2 months' (60 days') written notice when resigning. During probation the notice period is 2 weeks. Company property, including the laptop and ID badge, must be returned on the last working day, and the final settlement is paid with the next payroll run.

Who to Contact

id: 1 | category: Leave
Q: How do I request annual leave?
A: Log in to PeopleHub, go to My Profile > Leave > New Request, choose the dates and submit. Your line manager approves the request within 2 working days. Submit at least 5 working days in advance.

id: 2 | category: Leave
Q: Can I carry over unused annual leave to next year?
A: Yes. You may carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days, and they must be used by 31 March of the following year.

id: 3 | category: Leave
Q: Do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
A: A medical certificate is required only if you are absent for more than 2 consecutive working days.

id: 4 | category: Payroll
Q: When is salary paid?
A: Payroll is processed on the 25th of every month. Payslips are published on PeopleHub the same day. If the 25th falls on a weekend or public holiday, salary is paid on the preceding working day.

id: 5 | category: Expenses
Q: How long do I have to submit an expense claim?
A: Expense claims must be submitted in PeopleHub within 30 days of the expense. Receipts are mandatory for anything above PKR 2,000 (USD 10 abroad). Approved claims are reimbursed within 14 days.

id: 6 | category: Remote Work
Q: How many days a week can I work from home?
A: Confirmed employees can work remotely up to 3 days per week with line manager approval. Employees on probation work from the office full-time.

id: 7 | category: IT
Q: How do I access internal systems from outside the office?
A: Connect to the company VPN first. VPN access requires MFA. Contact itsupport@auroradynamics.example if you have not received your VPN profile.

id: 8 | category: IT
Q: How often do I need to change my password?
A: Passwords must be changed every 90 days. PeopleHub sends a reminder 7 days before expiry.

id: 9 | category: IT
Q: When can I get a new laptop?
A: Company laptops are refreshed every 3 years. An earlier replacement is only possible if IT Support confirms the device cannot be repaired.

id: 10 | category: Benefits
Q: Does the health insurance cover dental treatment?
A: No. Dental and optical treatment are not covered. The plan covers inpatient care in full and outpatient care up to PKR 50,000 per year for the employee, spouse and up to 2 children.

id: 11 | category: Benefits
Q: Is there a referral bonus?
A: Yes. Employees receive a referral bonus of PKR 50,000 once the person they referred completes probation.

id: 12 | category: Benefits
Q: What is the learning budget and who can use it?
A: Every confirmed employee has a learning budget of USD 1,000 per year for courses, certifications and conferences. It is not available during probation.

id: 13 | category: Probation
Q: How long is probation?
A: Probation lasts 3 months. It can be extended once by up to 3 more months if the probation review recommends it.

id: 14 | category: Resignation
Q: What is the notice period?
A: Confirmed employees must give 2 months (60 days) of written notice. During probation the notice period is 2 weeks.

id: 15 | category: General
Q: What is the dress code?
A: The dress code is smart casual. Formal business attire is expected on client-facing days.

AURORA DYNAMICS - LEAVE POLICY
Version 3.1 - Effective 1 January 2026
Owner: People Operations

1. PURPOSE
This policy explains the types of leave available to employees of Aurora Dynamics, how much leave
each employee is entitled to, and how leave is requested and approved. It applies to all permanent
employees in Lahore, Karachi and Dubai.

2. ANNUAL LEAVE
Every permanent employee is entitled to 20 paid annual leave days per calendar year. Leave accrues
monthly at a rate of 1.67 days per month of service and is credited to the employee's PeopleHub
balance at the start of each month.

Employees may carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year.
Carried-over days must be used by 31 March, after which they expire. Annual leave cannot be
encashed except at the time of final settlement.

Annual leave requests must be submitted in PeopleHub at least 5 working days in advance. Requests
for more than 5 consecutive days require 2 weeks' notice. Line managers approve or decline requests
within 2 working days.

3. SICK LEAVE
Employees are entitled to 10 paid sick leave days per year. Sick leave must be reported to the line
manager before 10:00 AM on the first day of absence. A medical certificate is required for any
absence of more than 2 consecutive working days. Unused sick leave does not carry over.

4. CASUAL LEAVE
Employees receive 6 casual leave days per year for urgent personal matters. Casual leave may be
taken for a maximum of 2 consecutive days and should be requested at least one day in advance where
possible.

5. PARENTAL LEAVE
Maternity leave: 12 weeks of fully paid leave. Employees should inform People Operations at least 8
weeks before the expected due date.
Paternity leave: 2 weeks of fully paid leave, to be taken within 3 months of the child's birth.
Adoption leave: 4 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary carer.

6. PUBLIC HOLIDAYS
The Company observes the public holidays announced in the annual government gazette for each office
location (typically 12 to 14 days). The holiday calendar is published on PeopleHub every January.

7. UNPAID LEAVE
Employees who have exhausted their paid leave may apply for unpaid leave of up to 30 days per year.
Unpaid leave requires approval from the Head of People Operations.

8. LEAVE DURING PROBATION
Annual leave accrues during probation but may only be taken with the line manager's approval and
normally not before the completion of the first 2 months of service. Sick leave is available from
day one.

9. HOW TO REQUEST LEAVE
All leave is requested through the PeopleHub portal: My Profile > Leave > New Request. The request
goes to the line manager for approval and the employee is notified by email. Leave balances are
visible on the PeopleHub dashboard at any time.

10. CONTACT
Questions about this policy: people@auroradynamics.example
